name: milestone-loop
description: Milestone workflow skills: app-overview, plan-milestones, find-parallel, next-milestone (implementation delegated to a subagent, then an automatic adversarial review gate before user testing), next-group (independent milestones implemented in parallel, tested together with one short script), close-milestone, hotfix, replan, milestone-status, plus non-invocable reference skills the workflow skills read: conventions (stack loading, language and labels, model tiers, parallel groups, integration branch, git safety) and per-stack rules (stack-web, stack-unity, stack-mechanical, stack-electronics, with physical-build shared by the physical stacks; a project may list several stacks).
